registros.pergunta: Quantas partidas tiveram exatamente a mesma quantidade de eliminações para as duas equipes?

resultados.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT game_id) AS partidas
FROM (
  SELECT game_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN side = 'Blue' THEN total_kills END) AS blue_kills,
         MAX(CASE WHEN side = 'Red' THEN total_kills END) AS red_kills
  FROM (
    SELECT game_id, side, SUM(kills) AS total_kills
    FROM pro_players
    GROUP BY game_id, side
  ) t
  GROUP BY game_id
  HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN side = 'Blue' THEN total_kills END) = 
         MAX(CASE WHEN side = 'Red' THEN total_kills END)
) s;

registros.pergunta: Quais foram os 5 campeões com maior presença em picks ou bans em 2026?

resultados.sql:
SELECT champion_name, COUNT(*) AS presenca
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT match_id, champion_name
  FROM participants
  WHERE champion_name IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT b.match_id, p.champion_name
  FROM bans b
  JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT champion_id, champion_name FROM participants) p
    ON p.champion_id = b.champion_id
)
WHERE match_id IN (
  SELECT match_id FROM matches WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM game_creation) = 2026
)
GROUP BY champion_name
ORDER BY presenca DESC
LIMIT 5;

registros.pergunta: Qual dupla de campeões de ADC e SUPPORT mais apareceu na mesma equipe?

FROM pro_players pp1

registros.pergunta: Qual dupla de campeões de ADC e SUPPORT teve a maior taxa de vitória, considerando pelo menos 20 partidas?

resultados.sql:
WITH dupla_adc_sup AS (
  SELECT 
    p_adc.champion_name AS adc,
    p_sup.champion_name AS support,
    p_adc.match_id,
    p_adc.win
  FROM participants p_adc
  JOIN participants p_sup 
    ON p_adc.match_id = p_sup.match_id 
    AND p_adc.team_id = p_sup.team_id
  WHERE p_adc.team_position = 'BOTTOM'
    AND p_sup.team_position = 'UTILITY'
)
SELECT 
  adc,
  support,
  AVG(win::int) AS win_rate
FROM dupla_adc_sup
GROUP BY adc, support
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY win_rate DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

registros.pergunta: Quais foram as 5 combinações de campeões de MIDDLE e JUNGLE mais utilizadas?

registros.pergunta: Qual campeão apresentou a maior diferença de KDA médio entre vitórias e derrotas?

resultados.sql:
SELECT 
  p.champion_name,
  AVG(CASE WHEN p.win THEN (p.kills + p.assists)::float / NULLIF(p.deaths, 0) ELSE NULL END) AS kda_vitoria,
  AVG(CASE WHEN NOT p.win THEN (p.kills + p.assists)::float / NULLIF(p.deaths, 0) ELSE NULL END) AS kda_derrota,
  AVG(CASE WHEN p.win THEN (p.kills + p.assists)::float / NULLIF(p.deaths, 0) ELSE NULL END) 
  - AVG(CASE WHEN NOT p.win THEN (p.kills + p.assists)::float / NULLIF(p.deaths, 0) ELSE NULL END) AS diferenca_kda
FROM participants p
GROUP BY p.champion_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY diferenca_kda DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

registros.pergunta: Qual posição teve a maior participação média no dano total causado pela equipe?

resultados.sql:
SELECT p.team_position, AVG(p.dmg_to_champions::float / t.total_dmg) AS avg_participation
FROM participants p
JOIN (
  SELECT match_id, team_id, SUM(dmg_to_champions) AS total_dmg
  FROM participants
  GROUP BY match_id, team_id
) t ON t.match_id = p.match_id AND t.team_id = p.team_id
WHERE t.total_dmg > 0
GROUP BY p.team_position
ORDER BY avg_participation DESC;

SELECT pp.position, AVG(pp.kills + pp.deaths + pp.assists) / 
       (SELECT AVG(total_contrib) FROM (
         SELECT SUM(kills + deaths + assists) AS total_contrib
         FROM pro_players GROUP BY game_id, side) s) AS avg_participation
FROM pro_players pp
GROUP BY pp.position
ORDER BY avg_participation DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM (
  SELECT game_id, team_name, 
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY series_id ORDER BY game_date, game_id) AS game_num,
         series_id
  FROM (
    SELECT pg.game_id, pg.team_name, pg.game_date,

) s
WHERE game_num = 5
GROUP BY team_name
